selection: Midpoint of the interpreted eastern entrance rim region; the plan places level 0.00 on this side. The physical station mark was not identified.
method: Remote interpretation of orthophoto corroborated by ALS shaft morphology; not GNSS.
limitations: The image pick and decimal precision do not determine accuracy. The physical station mark is unidentified. Absolute H is estimated from ALS 2012 in PL-KRON86-NH according to source metadata; relative heights alone are retained from the network. TPN NMT is only a cross-check with unknown vertical datum; no datum conversion was performed.
height_selection: Local plane through six nearest lower-surface ALS returns within 0.75 m; 1140.815 m rounded to one decimal. Surface identity interpreted at the eastern shaft rim; not a directly identified survey mark.
